versions.changelog:
vestafolio-interets-composes 1.2.1

- Now requires explicit user approval before transmitting investment parameters to Vestafolio’s external API; users are informed of the destination and contents before API calls.
- Summarizes the fields and values to be sent, and skips transmission if approval is declined; provides the simulator link as an alternative.
- Improved privacy practices: only submits necessary fields to the API, omitting any optional/personal data.
- Documentation and workflow updated to clarify user consent, approval handling, and response behaviour. 
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality, workflow, or user experience.

- Initial release of the Vestafolio compound interest simulation skill.
- Projects investment growth using initial capital, monthly contributions, duration, annual return, and compounding frequency.
- Interacts with Vestafolio’s API to provide year-by-year tables and accurate results matching the website.
- Handles missing input collection in French before performing calculations.
- Responds in French when prompted in French.
- Excludes tax, fees, or loan projections; pure compound interest only.
